command:
function chk($label,$cmdName,$verArgs){ "=== $label ==="; if(Get-Command $cmdName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ & $cmdName @verArgs 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3 } else { "$cmdName NOT INSTALLED" } }
chk "GIT" "git" @("--version")
chk "JAVA" "java" @("-version")
chk "PHP" "php" @("--version")
chk "FLUTTER" "flutter" @("--version")
chk "NODE" "node" @("--version")
"=== ANDROID SDK ==="
$env:ANDROID_HOME
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT
$sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Android\Sdk"
if(Test-Path $sdk){ $sdk } else { "Android SDK folder NOT FOUND" }
"=== DISK C FREE GB ==="
[Math]::Round((Get-PSDrive C).Free/1GB,1)
"=== OS ==="
(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).Caption
